question: Who wrote the book ‘Poverty and Un-British Rule in India’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dadabhai Naoroji.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Poverty and Un-British Rule in India (1901)** is the book **published by Dadabhai Naoroji **__which explained **“Drain Theory”.**
 
• The work even provides significant information on poverty estimation in India based on the observations Dadabhai Naoroji made in jail among the inmates based on their consumption patterns.
 
• Dadabhai Naoroji, the 'Grand Old Man
